items.h: Deion Burks goes for 41 yards in loss to Titans
items.s: Deion Burks caught both of his targets for 41 yards in the Colts' 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday. He also ran once for seven yards. The rookie had only caught one of four targets on the season leading into Sunday, but he put up a nice splash play for 36 yards. He could work his way into a larger workload if the Colts find his ability as a deep threat is superior to that of Laquon Treadwell.

The Colts selected Burks in the seventh round of the 2026 NFL Draft, 254th overall. No one would have thought anything of it if the Colts had taken Burks in the fourth round rather than the seventh, so this can only be seen as a close to the ideal end-of-draft selection. Burks' lack of production at Purdue and Oklahoma generally indicates a limitation in his wide receiver skill set, but if the weak parts of his game ever improve then he has the athleticism to become quite useful. Small as he is at 5-foot-10, 180 pounds, Burks' athleticism is loud -- his 4.30-second 40-yard dash, 42.5-inch vertical jump and 131-inch broad jump are all well above the 90th percentile for wide receivers.
